🎐Hands-On Guide

Session Agenda

Intelligence for Media Contents & Management

  • 컨텐츠 수명주기 전반에 걸친 미디어 자산의 체계적인 구성, 저장, 검색 및 관리를 위한 서비스와 솔루션을 소개하고 AWS AI 서비스와 통합하는 과정을 데모와 실습을 통해 파악합니다.

  • 미디어 콘텐츠 수명주기 전반에 걸친 콘텐츠 관리, 분석 및 모니터링을 위한 AWS 서비스와 솔루션을 이해하고 AI 서비스를 적용하여 가치를 고도화 하는 과정을 파악합니다.

AI feature

Additional

Use Case Demo

Use Case

  • **Image resizing for to meet platform requirements:
    **ML can automatically identify the center of an object and modify a photo to meet multiple sizing formats to meet specifications of a given
    platform

  • Automated Person, Logo/Brand identification of large libraries:

    use ML to query and tag deep content libraries of specific people, brands or logos to quickly create stories or clips of a given subject or art work to support stories

  • Text to speech:

    AI/ML can create human-like voices with unique dialects as needed to create audio versions or articles for easy listening on smart speakers
    like Alexa

  • Content evaluation for success:

    ML can help book publishers and editors in analyzing book manuscripts and comparing the same to bestsellers of the same genre using algorithms to identify the most marketable projects or a books chance for success

  • Copy-writing enforcement and plagiarism detection:

    Use ML for fact checking and plagiarism detection or copyright infringement which may otherwise be time-consuming for humans

  • Improvement in content offerings in distribution and monetization:

    ML and classification methods can be used to determine what type of content resonates best with the publisher’s audience and at what time

  • Content moderation:

    The New York Times deployed an AI based tool to moderate its reader comments section that detects abusive comments and labels them as toxic, creating flags for editors to remove

  • Auto text tagging:

    ML can auto generate text tags that helps with internet search elevation of books, articles for improved traffic generation

  • Content translation:

    ML can translate text into alternate languages providing a first draft for quick review and edits by human translators providing much quicker
    and cost effective way to expand the audience

  • Content recommendations:

    Analyze customer behavior and preferences to surface content relevant to them
